lines.text: David prays for God to hear him, because the enemy's pressure fills his heart with fear and the terrors of death.
David wishes for wings like a dove so he could fly to the temple and find rest.
David asks the Lord to confuse their speech, because he sees violence and strife in the city.
The one who turned on David is not an enemy but his servant, with whom he once walked into God's house.
David calls to God morning, noon, and night, casts his burden on the LORD, and says he will trust in Him.
